mapper.select: select bspcc.* from stra_his_file shf left join b_marketing_task btbp on shf.batch_number = btbp.batch_number left join b_marketing_task_extend bmte on btbp.id = bmte.task_id left join b_score_rule_config bsrc on bsrc.id = bmte.rule_id left join b_score_push_customer_config bspcc on bsrc.rule_name_short = bspcc.score_rule_short_name where shf.status =2 and shf.id =#{fileId} and shf.push_status !=1 and btbp.monitor_type !=2
